source.title: Let Me Make You An Offer
source.description: The first run's all packed up, <name>. Take this to Stormwind and get it in front of the higher-ups. Someone who can sign today!
source.objective: Take the Arms Shipment to Master Wood in Stormwind City.
source.progress: A delivery from Ratchet? I didn't order anything from Ratchet.
source.completion: An arms supplier in Ratchet? Well... the Alliance does need all the supplies we can get. And we don't want the Horde signing a deal. We should act fast.
